name: EPIC 206113085
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 7.2 solar radii and 0.92 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,029 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.92 solar masses and 7.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,786 K at its surface.
